description: Cache Rules (§1): anonymous public pages on joutiya.ma and aalan.ma are cached for the TTL the origin sends (ISR s-maxage); a production deploy purges the cache. Only locale-prefixed paths: '/' and unprefixed paths redirect per visitor. Bypassed as soon as the __Host-session cookie is present, or the __Host-preview pass of the closed site (src/lib/launch/preview.ts): an opened page must never be cached for the visitors still in front of the door. Private pages send no-store. Build assets (/_next/static) are cached by default.

rules.description: Anonymous public pages: cache, TTLs from the origin
rules.expression: http.host in {"joutiya.ma" "aalan.ma"} and (http.request.uri.path in {"/fr" "/ar" "/rif"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/fr/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ar/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/rif/")) and not http.cookie contains "__Host-session" and not http.cookie contains "__Host-preview"

rules.description: R2 media hosts (photos, PMTiles map): the edge keeps a copy one day at most, whatever the origin sends. Photos are stored with max-age=86400 (those stored before 2026-11-04 with max-age=31536000, immutable; the PMTiles map keeps a year), so the photos of a removed, refused or hidden listing leave the CDN within a day of their move to the private bucket; the app purges each deleted URL at once when CF_MEDIA_PURGE_TOKEN is set.
